result.summary: Wrote s802/r3/lit.md (26.8KB) covering literature topics L9-L12 from analysis.md §5, targeting core α (short-window second-moment-of-a-second-moment structure, cross_cov(cross_cov(day_max(Ret),day_cov(Ret,Ret),3),...,3)) and core β (day_kurt(Ret)). Searched only pre-2023-08-08 sources via WebSearch/WebFetch, verifying dates via Crossref/NBER/journal pages. Cited 12 verified sources: Baltussen/van Bekkum/van der Grient 2018 (vol-of-vol, JFQA), Fičura 2019 (realized moments windows, EFAJ), Su/Shu/Yin 2018 (China common idiosyncratic volatility, Physica A), Amaya/Christoffersen/Jacobs/Vasquez 2015 (realized skewness/kurtosis, JFE), Barndorff-Nielsen/Kinnebrock/Shephard 2008/2010 (realized semivariance), Bollerslev/Li/Zhao 2020 (good/bad volatility, JFQA), Hou/Moskowitz 2005 (price delay R²-ratio, RFS), Liu/Stambaugh/Yuan 2019 (China size/value, JFE), Li/Rao 2022 (revised China factor model, Economic Modelling), Acadian 2020-04 (China suspension stats), MSCI 2017-09 methodology, Ait-Sahalia/Yu 2008/2009 (microstructure noise, NBER/Annals of Applied Statistics). Each processing recipe translated into this environment's operator language (e.g. div(day_wmean(Ret,Ret), day_std(Ret)) as the operator analog of Bollerslev-Li-Zhao's normalized good-minus-bad volatility). One highly relevant paper (Dai et al., Finance Research Letters) was found but excluded after Crossref confirmed December 2023 publication / 2023-08-25 metadata registration, both after the cutoff - recorded honestly in the "not used" section rather than cited. Several genuine search gaps (slope-vs-t-value comparison, 100-vs-200-day window comparison, minimum-observation thresholds, direct China vol-of-vol evidence, an unreadable D.E. Shaw PDF) were recorded honestly rather than papered over.
